arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near critical power (pod ~172 W shaft, boat ~101 W) after the hard start, keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above ~25% until the last 1000 m, then spend it all from ~800 m to go (finish cue). Compare same-direction legs to separate current/wind from paddler. Watch for instrument drift (pod vs GPS disagree), rudder fouling (speed drops at same pod power), course/radio changes. Cue only when it changes something.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 30%: check pacing, consider ease
Boat slower than pod power predicts beyond current: weed on rudder, drag, or pod drift?
Shaft power well below critical power for 30 s: fading, distracted, or pod drift?

arguments.reason: Check the paddler settled after the hard start (shaft power near 172-180 W)

text: no cue: hard start is expected to settle; plan, three watches and a wake-up at 2.4 min set to check it does

arguments.text: 2.4 min, leg 1 (north): pod shaft 183 W vs CP 172 (sustainable 177), pod reserve 68%. Boat model says 118 W vs CP 101, reserve 57% and empties in 550 m. push_local +0.10-0.15 m/s with no turn yet: likely a helping current on leg 1 inflating boat-model power. Trusting the pod for effort; check after the first turn whether leg 2 shows push_local negative (current against).

arguments.reason: After turn 1: compare leg 2 push_local and boat vs pod power to confirm current; check pacing

text: no cue: paddler has settled to 183 W shaft, close to the pod sustainable 177 W; boat-model reserve looks inflated by a likely helping current, will check after turn 1
no cue: just turned onto leg 2; pod effort 179 W is near sustainable 176 W; wake at 4850 m to go will compare leg 2 against leg 1

arguments.reason: Boat-model reserve read 0% while the paddler holds 3.07-3.11 m/s steadily on both legs 1 and 2 (no current: push_along ~0, same GPS speed both directions) at pod 176-181 W, only 5% over pod CP 172. Boat/shaft power ratio 0.64 in race vs 0.59 at test: boat CP rescaled to 0.644 x 172 = 111 W and boat reserve to 0.644 x 13.3 = 8.5 kJ to match the pod.

arguments.text: 6.3 min, 4850 m to go: no current (legs 1 and 2 both 3.07-3.11 m/s GPS, push_along ~0). Boat CP corrected to 111 W / 8.5 kJ (1 of 3 corrections used): boat reserve now 81%, pod 60%. Pod is my effort reference: 180 W vs CP 172, sustainable 176. Paddler says 4/10, plenty: hint that real CP is above the test. Plan: hold even effort now; if at 3000 m to go pod effort still ~180 W with steady speed and paddler still under 6/10, ask for a push to ~185-190 W; finish sprint from ~700 m.

arguments.reason: Halfway check: decide on a push using pod reserve, fade, and paddler effort

text: no cue: no current, boat CP corrected to 111 W to match the pod, paddler feels 4/10 at near-sustainable pod effort; holding even and reviewing at 3000 m to go

arguments.text: Speed has slipped. Lift back to 2:42 pace, same rate.

9.4 min, 4250 m to go: pod shaft fell 177 -> 149 W over 75 s (race s 483-557) at unchanged rate 64, but GPS speed only fell 3.08 -> 3.01 (expected ~2.91 if effort truly fell 16%). Paddler again says 4/10, plenty. Either a lull or pod reading low (drift). Cued push to 2:42 pace (162 s/500, GPS-anchored, what they held for 5 min). Check: if speed returns to ~3.08 but pod stays well below ~178, the pod is drifting low: then trust GPS speed and boat model, not pod reserve.

arguments.reason: Check response to the push cue and whether pod and speed agree (pod drift?)

text: cued push to 2:42 pace: speed slipped 3% at the same rate while the paddler says 4/10; pod fell more than speed, possible pod drift, checking in 90 s

arguments.text: 10.1 min, 4140 m to go: POD LOOKS UNRELIABLE. Pod fell 178 -> 131 W (-26%) and keeps falling while GPS speed only 3.08 -> 3.02 (-2%), rate 64 unchanged, boat model 115 -> 106 W, paddler 4/10 plenty. Pod reserve (63%) and push_local (+0.25) now meaningless. Use GPS speed, rate and the corrected boat model (CP 111 W, 8.5 kJ) instead. Push cue at 9.5 min got no speed response (3.03). Test after turn 2: if leg 3 (north) speed matches leg 2, it is pod drift not a tailwind hiding an effort drop. Speed through water is down ~2.5% at same rate: watch for a drag cause (weed) too.

arguments.message: Boat-model reserve below 25% (pod unreliable): check pacing

arguments.reason: After turn 2: compare leg 3 speed with leg 2 (pod drift vs tailwind), decide on push

arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back, no current found on legs 1-2. From 10 min the POD reads falsely low (drift): judge effort from GPS speed, stroke rate and the boat model (CP corrected to 111 W / 8.5 kJ). Target: hold ~3.05-3.10 m/s (2:41-2:44 pace) while the boat reserve stays above ~30%; paddler says 4/10, plenty, so a small push in legs 4-5 is fine if speed responds and the boat reserve allows; finish sprint from ~700 m to go. Watch for a drag cause (weed: speed falls at same rate) and radio/course changes. Cue only when it changes something.

text: no cue (gate closed for 20 s): pod is reading falsely low while speed held; switched watches and plan to GPS speed and the boat model, will judge after turn 2

arguments.text: Quick back-stroke, clear the rudder, then straight back to rhythm.

11.0 min, 3980 m to go: leg 3 (north) speed 3.01-3.03 same as late leg 2, so no tailwind; pod settled ~135 W = drift low. But boat 2-3% slower at same rate 64 since ~8.5 min (fade -2.3%) and the 9.5-min push cue moved nothing. Tested for weed with a clear_rudder cue at 11.0 min. Next: if speed recovers to ~3.08, it was weed; if not, cue push to 2:42 again.

arguments.reason: Did clear_rudder dip and restore speed? If not, cue push to 2:42

arguments.text: 11.5 min, 3880 m to go: clear_rudder cue NOT done (no back-stroke seen, no dip), yet speed came back to 3.10 m/s water in the last 30 s (boat 118 W vs CP 111, reserve 74%, sustainable pace 162.1 vs 161.4 now). Pod still 141 W at that speed: pod drift confirmed. On target, no cue needed.

text: no cue: speed back to 3.10 m/s, right on the boat-model sustainable pace; pod drift confirmed, next check at 3000 m to go
no cue: holding 3.07-3.10 m/s on the boat-model sustainable pace with the boat reserve lasting past the finish; halfway check at 3000 m to go

arguments.text: 16.4 min, 3000 m to go: legs 1-3 GPS 3.10 / 3.06 / 3.09 m/s, boat 115 / 111 / 117 W, rate 64, no current, no fade. Boat reserve 52%, sustainable pace 162.3 vs 163.6 now: even pacing is right. Paddler has said the same 4/10 plenty three times (6, 9, 16 min): treat as unreliable. Plan: hold to ~1500 m to go, then judge the reserve left for a progressive build and a finish sprint sized to what remains (do not empty it early).

Finish cue point: cue finish if reserve allows

arguments.text: Boat is dragging. One back-stroke now to clear the rudder.

22.4 min, 1900 m to go (leg 5, north): GPS speed fell 3.06 -> 2.82 m/s from race s 1284 (before turn 4, still heading south) through 1338, pod steady 139-141 W (drifted but stable), rate 64: speed lost at same effort = drag (weed on rudder?) not a direction-dependent push; earlier turns showed no such dip. Cued clear_rudder at 22.4 min. Next: if back-stroke seen and speed back to ~3.06, weed cleared; if speed stays low after a back-stroke, suspect headwind/current on leg 5 and compare with leg 3.

arguments.text: 23.3 min, 1720 m to go: weed confirmed and cleared. Paddler said boat felt heavy; back-stroke seen at ~22.6 min (35% dip); 30-s speed now climbing back (2.95 and rising as the dip leaves the window). During the drag the boat model read low power and refilled the boat reserve 41% -> 51%, falsely (pod effort unchanged). True boat reserve now about 37%: sustainable ~116-117 W boat, about 3.07-3.10 m/s. Finish sprint only from ~450-500 m to go, not 750.

Last 1700 m. Pod reads falsely low since 10 min: judge by GPS speed, rate and boat model (CP 111 W / 8.5 kJ). Boat reserve reads ~12 points too high after the weed episode (true ~37% at 1720 m to go). Hold ~3.07-3.10 m/s (2:41-2:43) to ~500 m to go, then cue finish. Weed was on the rudder at 21.5-22.6 min and was cleared: if speed again falls at same rate and pod, cue clear_rudder at once.

text: no cue (gate closed): weed cleared by the back-stroke and speed is recovering; plan updated for a finish from ~500 m with a corrected view of the reserve

arguments.text: Rudder is clear. Build to 2:41 pace through the last turn.

24.6 min, 1500 m to go: after the weed, speed settled 3.02-3.05 (fade -2%), pod a touch lower 138 W. True reserve ~35% (boat model says 49%, inflated by the weed). Even spend of it is ~117 W = 3.09-3.10 m/s, so cued push to 2:41 (161 s/500) at 24.6 min. Finish cue at ~480 m to go.

text: cued push to 2:41 pace: speed sat 1-2% below what the remaining reserve supports after the weed was cleared; finish cue planned at 480 m to go

Push cue at 24.6 min was not followed (pod 142 -> 140, speed 3.02 -> 2.97). Boat power ~105-111 W ~ CP, so true reserve still ~35% (~3 kJ). Finish cue moved to 600 m to go.
